# anthropic_spend_limits (Data Source)

Lists the effective per-user spend limits of a Claude Enterprise organization, including limits inherited from seat tiers, groups or the organization. Requires `enterprise_api_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_spend_limits" "monthly" {
  periods = ["monthly"]
}

output "users_over_default" {
  value = [
    for row in data.anthropic_spend_limits.monthly.spend_limits : row.email
    if row.source_type == "user"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `periods` (List of String) Periods to return (`daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`). Defaults to the API default (monthly).
- `user_ids` (List of String) Restrict to these user ids (at most 100).

### Read-Only

- `spend_limits` (Attributes List) One row per user and period. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spend_limits))

<a id="nestedatt--spend_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spend_limits`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Effective cap in minor units (cents) as a string; null when unlimited.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.
- `email` (String) User email; null when unavailable.
- `name` (String) User name; null when unavailable.
- `period` (String) `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`.
- `period_to_date_spend` (String) Spend so far in the current period, as a decimal string.
- `source_id` (String) Identifier of the source (user id, seat tier, group id or service name); null for `organization`.
- `source_type` (String) Where the limit comes from: `user`, `seat_tier`, `rbac_group`, `organization_service` or `organization`.
- `spend_limit_id` (String) Id of the spend limit row the source resolves to.
- `user_id` (String) User id.
